programs.title: Life Is Messy
programs.desc: Ranjit bought her little home when she was a bachelorette; fast-forward 20 years later, and the walls are closing in on her family of three. Ranjit and husband Nabeel are in desperate need of a reset, but they don't know how to start. Kortney and Kenny guide them through a massive declutter, turning a man cave into a teenage-friendly space, making room for living, and calming the chaos.
